editorial:
Imagine being stuck at sea for years while angry gods try to ruin your life. You get to follow Odysseus, a smart king who just wants to get back to his wife and son after a massive war. The vibe here is huge and exciting, mixing old myths with a modern feel. You will feel the stress of the crew as they face giant monsters and weird islands. It feels like a giant road trip where everything that can go wrong actually does, and you will find yourself rooting for Odysseus to outsmart his way home.

The action scenes are the best part, especially the fight with the Cyclops which looks totally real. The acting is top-notch, and the movie never feels too slow. One downside is that some of the plot jumps might confuse you if you are not paying attention. If you love big adventures, you need to see this.
endingExplained: After finally reaching Ithaca, Odysseus hides his identity to test who is still loyal. He enters a big archery contest that only he can win. Once he proves who he is, he fights and kills all the rude men who tried to steal his throne. He reunites with his wife, Penelope, after twenty years apart. The movie ends with peace returning to the land and the gods finally leaving him alone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves Greek myths and big adventure stories.
